Name: Scandic Stavanger Forus
Company description: Sentralt plassert forretnings- og konferansehotell på Norges viktigste næringsområde, Forus. 10 minutter til Stavanger Lufthavn, Sola. 15 minutter til både Stavanger og Sandnes sentrum.

Name: Nordic Choice Hotels
Company description: Nordic Choice Hotels, now rebranded as Strawberry, is a leading hotel chain in the Nordic region, renowned for its innovative approach to hospitality and strong commitment to sustainability. With over 245 hotels across the Nordics and Baltics, the company focuses on creating memorable experiences for its guests by providing modern amenities, personalized service, and a welcoming atmosphere that feels like home. The mission of Strawberry revolves around delivering high-quality service, sustainability, and inclusivity, ensuring that every guest feels valued and comfortable during their stay.  The company caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, families, and leisure seekers, and actively partners with various organizations to enhance guest experiences and promote local attractions. Strawberry is dedicated to environmental responsibility, striving to be climate neutral by 2030 and taking significant steps to reduce food waste, reflecting its vision of responsible hospitality.  In addition to its commitment to sustainability, Nordic Choice Hotels offers unique experiences, such as the Wallmans Stockholm Dinner Party, which combines dining with entertainment, appealing to families and leisure guests. The company embraces technology, exemplified by its pioneering use of digital key cards in Google Wallet, which streamlines check-in and room access for guests.  With a focus on continuous growth and innovation, Strawberry aims to create unforgettable moments for its guests in vibrant cities, tranquil islands, and charming towns throughout the Nordics and Baltics. By promoting clean energy and equal rights through its partnerships, Nordic Choice Hotels ensures a welcoming environment for all, making it a preferred choice for travelers seeking both comfort and a commitment to sustainability.

Name: First Hotels
Company description: Since 1993, First Hotels has been working hard to create the hotels of the future by redefining the hotel experience.  It’s our goal to be a leader in hotel development and offer an element of surprise, while at the same time caring for our employees, guests, and customers. We want to go beyond the ordinary hotel experience and make you feel at home, the second you walk through the door. It’s not about merely booking a room with a bed, it’s about having a place to relax, work and just… be. As an extension of your everyday life, Your second home is FIRST.  With more than 27 unique and centrally located hotels at selected destinations in Sweden, Norway and Denmark, you’re set for holistic, memorable, local experiences. All of our hotels have free, unlimited WiFi to make it easier to stay in touch with the world.  We want to leave you with a feeling of Joy, Care and Innovation, regardless if you stay with us, work with us, meet with us or experience with us.

Name: ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions | Hospitality
Company description: ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions | Hospitality is a leading provider of advanced security solutions tailored specifically for the hospitality industry. The company specializes in innovative access control systems, including RFID locks and electronic cylinders, designed to enhance guest experiences while ensuring operational efficiency for hotels and resorts. With a mission to deliver seamless integration and future-proof scalability, ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions partners with a diverse range of clients, including hotel chains, independent properties, and service providers, to create secure and user-friendly environments. Their commitment to quality and reliability is reflected in their cutting-edge products, such as the Vingcard system, which facilitates maintenance and configuration through direct communication interfaces. By focusing on the unique needs of the hospitality sector, ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions aims to redefine security standards and elevate the overall guest experience.

Name: Grand Hotel Oslo
Company description: The Grand Hotel Oslo is Norway’s most iconic hotel. The heritage hotel first opened its doors in 1874 and for 150 years it has been host to the people of Norway, international guests, world leaders, celebrities and the Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Everyone deserves to feel Grand!  Our guest experience is based on true Nordic luxury delivered by our well-trained and enthusiastic international team. Grand Hotel Oslo has 283 rooms, including 54 suites. The hotel is a blend of historic design with a modern twist and includes a rooftop bar with magnificent views, Palmen restaurant, a modern and buzzing lobby bar, banquet and conference departments as well as a spa, a fitness room and on-site parking facilities.  Welcome to Oslo!

Name: Linstow
Company description: Linstow AS is a leading real estate company based in Norway, dedicated to the ownership, development, and management of a diverse portfolio of properties, including hotels, shopping centers, offices, and healthcare facilities. With a strong presence in the Baltic region, Linstow has established itself as a key player in the hotel and shopping center markets, while also engaging in significant urban development projects in Norway. The company's mission is to create vibrant spaces that enhance quality of life and promote societal well-being, focusing on sustainable growth and health-promoting urban development through innovative initiatives like the "Building Health" project in collaboration with SINTEF. Linstow's clientele includes international hotel brands such as Radisson, as well as a variety of commercial tenants, reflecting its broad market appeal. The company partners with local developers, municipalities, and public authorities to foster sustainable urban development, ensuring that its projects not only meet current needs but also contribute positively to the environment and community. Linstow's commitment to sustainability is evident in its pursuit of BREEAM certification and its emphasis on creating energy-efficient properties. Targeting both local and international markets, Linstow aims to lead the real estate sector by addressing demographic challenges and promoting social interaction through its developments. The company is wholly owned by AWAS Holding AS, part of the family-owned Awilhelmsen Group, which focuses on industrial investments and real estate. With a vision to enhance urban landscapes and drive economic development, Linstow AS is committed to long-term ownership and management, ensuring that its projects are inclusive and beneficial to local communities.

Name: Sit
Company description: Henrykte studenter – felles engasjement! Sit skal bidra til at studentene i Gjøvik, Ålesund og Trondheim får en trygg og effektiv studiesituasjon. Vi bygger og drifter boliger, driver barnehager, spisesteder, kiosker, helsetjeneste, bokhandel og treningssentre. Vi er styrt av studentene, og alt vi tjener kommer studentene til gode her og nå – eller i framtida.

Name: StInn - Inland Norway Students Union
Company description: StInn - Inland Norway Students Union is a pivotal organization dedicated to representing and supporting students across various educational institutions in the Inland Norway region, particularly at the Inland Norway University of Applied Sciences. Its mission is to enhance the student experience by advocating for student rights, promoting welfare, and fostering a vibrant community through a range of activities and services. StInn collaborates closely with local universities, colleges, and governmental bodies to ensure that students' voices are heard and their needs are met, addressing the unique challenges faced by both domestic and international students. The union serves a diverse clientele, including students from various backgrounds and fields of study, and aims to create an inclusive environment that encourages participation in academic, cultural, and social activities. Through various initiatives, events, and support services, StInn strives to empower students, enriching their academic and social lives while facilitating their engagement in broader societal issues. The organization is committed to promoting inclusivity, diversity, and active participation in both academic and social life, ultimately working to improve the overall quality of student life in the region. StInn's target market primarily includes students enrolled at the university, as well as prospective students seeking a supportive and enriching educational environment. By providing resources, organizing events, and facilitating engagement with academic and social issues, StInn aims to create a positive atmosphere that fosters personal and academic growth among its members. Through its collaborative efforts with local and national partners, StInn ensures that the voices of students are considered in decision-making processes that affect their education and well-being.

Name: Sommerro
Company description: Sommerro is a vibrant venue that hosts a variety of engaging events, with a particular focus on entertainment and humor. One of its standout offerings is "Les Femmes Frites," an energetic panel show featuring three of Norway's most charismatic women: Sigrid Bonde Tusvik, Siri Kristiansen, and Benedicte WesselHolst. The show invites audiences to enjoy a night filled with humor, sharp opinions, and unique perspectives as the panel discusses everything from current events to the absurdities of everyday life. Sommerro aims to create a dynamic and inclusive atmosphere, ensuring an engaging experience for all attendees. With a target market that includes humor enthusiasts and those seeking a lively night out, Sommerro is committed to delivering memorable events that resonate with its audience.

Name: THE THIEF
Company description: THE THIEF is a premier hotel located in Oslo, Norway, offering luxurious accommodations and unique experiences for its guests. The hotel is dedicated to providing exceptional service and creating memorable stays, with a mission to blend comfort and sophistication in a vibrant urban setting. Guests at THE THIEF enjoy exclusive access to the nearby Astrup Fearnley Museum, enhancing their cultural experience with contemporary art exhibitions. The hotel caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, art enthusiasts, and tourists seeking a high-end experience in the heart of Oslo. With a focus on quality and guest satisfaction, THE THIEF aims to be a leading destination for those looking to explore the rich cultural landscape of the city.

Name: De Bergenske
Company description: De Bergenske is a distinguished family of unique and exclusive hotels and restaurants located in the heart of Bergen, Norway. Committed to showcasing the best of Bergen's culinary and hospitality offerings, the company operates over 12 establishments, including the renowned Engen Steakhouse and Wesselstuen, which serve a variety of traditional and contemporary dishes made from high-quality, locally sourced ingredients. With a mission to create memorable experiences that go beyond guest expectations, De Bergenske prides itself on its deep-rooted connection to the local community, led by a family that embodies Bergen's spirit. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including families, business travelers, and tourists, and collaborates with local partners to enhance the cultural and culinary landscape of the region. Through its modern architectural designs and warm atmospheres, De Bergenske aims to bring people together, fostering connections over exceptional food and hospitality.

Name: Thon Hotels
Company description: Thon Hotels is a prominent hotel chain in Norway, specializing in providing exceptional accommodations and conference facilities. With a mission to deliver outstanding service and a focus on quality, Thon Hotels aims to be the leading provider of conference experiences in the country. The company offers a range of flexible meeting spaces, including modern conference rooms equipped with the latest technology, catering to both corporate clients and private events. Thon Hotels partners with local producers to emphasize sustainable, homemade, and organic food options, ensuring a unique culinary experience for guests. Targeting business travelers, event organizers, and leisure visitors, Thon Hotels is committed to creating memorable stays and events through personalized service and attention to detail.

Name: Citybox Hotels
Company description: Welcome to the future of hotel accommodation! At Citybox we’re all about modernization and innovation. We’ve thrown out minibars, bellboys, TV sets and room service. As a result we offer modern and affordable hotel rooms, with free wi-fi and self service check in, located in the centre of the city. Our rooms are cheap because we keep our running expenses down, while still offering our guests what they really need: a simple and stylish room with a delicate bathroom, comfortable bed, a good chair, a desk and a place for hanging your clothes. Wireless broadband is available free of charge throughout the hotels. Citybox combines simplicity with comfort and low prices. We aim for our hotels to be centrally located. If you want to spend your money on something other than a minibar and room service, then Citybox is the place for you. Our locations are filled with bars. Why would you need one in your hotel room?

Name: Magic Hotels
Company description: Magic Hotels consists of 4 new Signature Brand Design Hotels located in the heart of the Hanseatic City of  Bergen, Norway. The group of unique and high comfort hotels, are specially designed by top New York designer Karim Rashid.  Karim Rashid is one of the most famous international designers in the field of product design, fashion, furniture, lighting and art.  High service standards, valuable materials and splendid  design are the distinctive features of Magic Hotels.  Magic Hotel Solheimsviken The first Magic Hotel opened in August 2017 and offers 217 unique and well decorated rooms just in the surburb of the city center. Business areas such as Solheimsviken, Marineholmen and Danmarks-plass in the immediate neighbourhood.   Magic Hotel Xhibiton Located in the middle of Bergen city center, Magic Hotel Xhibition is surrounded by the best of what Bergen’s night life and dining scene has to offer. The Hotel is situated in the city’s most recent shopping mall, and shares roof with popular clubs and café’s.  Magic Hotel Korskirken In the middle of the Historical Centre of Bergen you will find Magic Hotel Bergen. Located a stone throw from the city’s famous fish market and surrounded by Bergen’s oldest buildings. With more than 20 restaurants in the immediate vicinity, guests can enjoy both Bergen’ surroundingss history and its culinary experiences in sweet harmony.  Breakfast, lunch and dinner is served in restaurant Villa Blanca. Magic Hotel Kløverhuset Spectacular view over Bergen's most famous landmark – Bryggen. Central location at what used to be Europe's oldest shopping center - Kløverhuset. Now Bergen's newest design hotel

Name: Norlandia Hotel Group
Company description: Vår kjernevirksomhet er hotelldrift og utvikling, samt prosjektering av nye hotellprodukter. Gjennom strategiske samarbeid med anerkjente merkenavn, skal vi skape unike merverdier for våre hoteller og samarbeidspartnere.  Med 27 egeneide hotellselskaper/management hoteller i Norge og Sverige, drevet av høyt motiverte og dyktige ledere, er vi i dag en betydelig aktør i det nordiske hotelldriftssegmentet.

Name: Grand Hotel Terminus
Company description: Grand Hotel Terminus is a distinguished hotel located in the heart of Bergen, known for its classic elegance and rich history. As part of the De Bergenske collection, the hotel aims to provide exceptional hospitality experiences that celebrate the unique charm of Bergen. With a commitment to sustainability and a long-standing family heritage, Grand Hotel Terminus caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, business professionals, and event organizers seeking a memorable stay in a culturally vibrant city. The hotel features luxurious accommodations, fine dining options, and versatile conference facilities, making it an ideal choice for both relaxation and business engagements. Through its dedication to quality service and local experiences, Grand Hotel Terminus strives to create lasting memories for its guests while promoting the best of Bergen's offerings.

Name: Clarion Hotel Post
Company description: Step into timeless elegance at Clarion Hotel® Post, providing everything you need for a wonderful stay in the heart of Gothenburg, right next to the central station.  This striking former post office has been transformed into a modern oasis with award-winning restaurants, music, art, cocktails, wines and first-class wellness facilities. We're pretty sure you'll feel right at home here! Service with a personal touch The people who work here are truly passionate about what they do – and that is reflected in the high level of service they provide. They take pride in what they do, and coupled with their natural curiosity, guests are set for a fabulous experience for all the senses!  Meetings, entertainment & experiences Clarion Hotel® Post is not just a hotel, it's also a popular arena for all kinds of meetings, events, music, pop-ups, art and design! Make sure to check out what's on next time you come here! The year is filled with an exciting programme featuring culinary events, parties, shows, DJ sessions, wine tastings, live music, exhibitions, trade fairs and much more – no matter what you're into, you're sure to find something you enjoy! Looking for job opportunities at Clarion Hotel®, look here: https://jobs.strawberryhotels.com/

Name: Oslofjord Convention Center AS
Company description: Oslofjord Convention Center is characterized by its multifunctional and flexible solutions. The facilities and technical systems create nearly boundless possibilities for presentations, entertainment, catering, accommodations(12.500 beds) to dining. These capacities allow Oslofjord to host conferences and events of the highest quality. Of the centers total area of 24,000 m2, 10,500 m2 are dedicated to the conference area itself. We enjoy a state-of-the-art conference hall with a 6,800-seat capacity, flexible staging, lighting, a world-class sound system and excellent image quality displayed on multi immense screens. Oslofjord is waiting to make your convention, concert,  banquet, sporting event or other event concept an absolute success.

Name: Lily Country Club
Company description: Lily Country Club is a premier destination that combines luxury accommodation, fine dining, and a range of recreational activities, including golf and spa services. The club's mission is to provide an exceptional experience for guests through high-quality service and a variety of tailored packages for events, conferences, and private gatherings. With award-winning recognition as Norway's Leading Conference Hotel 2024, Lily Country Club caters to both corporate clients and leisure travelers, offering facilities that include modern meeting rooms and a renowned golf course. The target market includes families, business professionals, and individuals seeking relaxation and unique experiences, such as alpaca walks and teambuilding activities. Through its commitment to excellence and community engagement, Lily Country Club aims to create memorable moments for all its visitors.

Name: Britannia Hotel
Company description: Founded in 1870, Britannia Hotel has a rich history, including serving royalty, explorers & dignitaries. The hotel reopened in April 2019, after a dramatic renovation totaling $150 million. As the northernmost member of The Leading Hotels of The World, Britannia features 5-star service, 224 rooms, 2 bars, 4 restaurants (including a MICHELIN star), 13 meeting rooms and a large Spa.  Perfectly located near sights & attractions. Britannia Hotel is located in the city center of Trondheim, Norway, just 28 minutes from (TRD) Trondheim International Airport. Trondheim was the original capital of Norway, founded by Viking King Olav Tryggvason in 997 AD. Today it is the third largest city in Norway and offers numerous outdoor activities, and historic sites & attractions. All Rooms include: • Breakfast buffet, with à la carte options, in iconic Palmehaven dinng room • Complimentary access to Britannia Fitness • Free in-room TV channels and Chromecasting from your own devices • Handcrafted beds by Hästens. 100% cotton linens  • Down duvets and pillows from Høie • Bathrobe and slippers • Fully stocked minibar with cool drinks and sweet and salty snacks • Safe • Nespresso machine and tea kettle • Hairdryer • Turn-down service • Complimentary in-room bottled water • Iron and ironing board • Full range of bath amenities by D. R. Harris • Complimentary high-speed WiFi

Name: Norges Arktiske Studentsamskipnad
Company description: Norges arktiske studentsamskipnad (Samskipnaden) er en velferdsorganisasjon for studentene ved UiT Norges arktiske universitet (UiT). Bedriften har 450 ansatte. Gjennom tjenester som studentbolig, barnehager, Mat & drikke, Helse og rådgiving, idrettshall, Studentliv og studenthus, skal Samskipnaden bidra til at studenter i Tromsø, Alta, Hammerfest, Narvik. Harstad og Svalbard får et godt arktisk studentliv.  Samskipnaden har 11 boligområder med over 2100 utleieenheter for studenter i Tromsø, 365 boenheter i Alta, 40 i Hammerfest, 340 i Narvik og 190 i Harstad.I tillegg kommer 210 studenthybler tilknyttet Universitetssenteret på Svalbard (UNIS).  Samskipnaden driver 20 spisesteder i Tromsø, Alta og Hammerfest, kiosk på campus Tromsø og cateringvirksomhet i Alta og Tromsø.  Samskipnaden har fem studentbarnehager i Tromsø og én i Alta - Breivika, Gimle, Prestvannet, Storskogåsen, Universet, samt Nyland studentbarnehage. Studentbarnehagene har et tilbud tilpasset studenters behov. Studentrådgivinga er en tjeneste som hjelper studentene i sosiale og praktiske forhold rundt studiene både i Tromsø og Alta, og som har et eget opplegg for å hjelpe utenlandske studenter med å finne seg til rette i Tromsø.  Kraft studentidrettssenter og Elverhøy studenttreningssenter drives av Samskipnaden, begge i Tromsø. Kraft har Tromsøs mest allsidige treningstilbud med sentral beliggenhet på universitetsområdet og studentvennlige priser.  Samskipnaden eier studenthus både i Tromsø og Atla. Studentsamfunnet Driv AS i Tromsø er Nord-Norges største konsertarrangør og blir delvis drevet på dugnadsbasis av studentene i Tromsø. I Alta er det Studenhuset City som er studentenes storstue.

Name: Losby Gods
Company description: Losby Gods is a premier destination that offers a unique blend of golf experiences and corporate event services, set in a picturesque natural environment. The company aims to provide an engaging and enjoyable introduction to golf for all skill levels, facilitated by top-notch instruction from renowned golf pro David Lloyd. Their mission is to create memorable social activities that serve as refreshing breaks during conferences and meetings, promoting both physical well-being and team bonding. Losby Gods caters to a diverse clientele, including corporate groups and organizations looking for innovative team-building activities, with options for both outdoor and indoor golfing experiences. The company emphasizes fun and camaraderie, ensuring that every participant, whether a beginner or an experienced golfer, leaves with a smile and a desire to continue playing.

Name: Rondane Høyfjellshotell
Company description: Rondane Høyfjellshotell is a mountain resort situated at the edge of the Rondane National Park in central Norway. Rondane National Park was the first national park in Norway, protected since 1962 and boasting huge areas of unspoilt, pristine nature as well as the largest herds of wild reindeer in Norway. Within daily hiking reach of the hotel you can find some 10 peaks above 2000 metres altitude.

Name: Hotell Refsnes Gods
Company description: Refsnes Gods (Manor) anno 1767, is not only a historic memorial, but also a hotel in a class by itself. Excellent food, wine and personal service are all in the finest traditions and are an important part of the hotel experience. In recent years, art have been added as a fourth element, today the htoel contains a considerable collection for Nordic contermporary art.

Name: Clarion Hotel Trondheim
Company description: Clarion Hotel Trondheim is a premier hotel located in Trondheim, Norway, known for its blend of modern comfort and traditional hospitality. The hotel specializes in providing exceptional accommodation, dining, and event services, catering to both leisure and business travelers. With a mission to create memorable experiences for its guests, Clarion Hotel Trondheim focuses on delivering high-quality service and a welcoming atmosphere. The hotel serves a diverse clientele, including families, corporate groups, and tourists, and partners with local businesses to enhance guest experiences. Its target market includes individuals seeking a comfortable stay, as well as organizations looking for venues for conferences and celebrations. The hotel aims to provide a unique experience that combines comfort, elegance, and local culture, making it an ideal choice for events such as weddings, conferences, and family gatherings. Clarion Hotel Trondheim is committed to delivering high-quality dining options and personalized service to ensure guest satisfaction. The hotel attracts a diverse clientele, including tourists seeking relaxation and local residents looking for a venue for special occasions. Its partnerships with local businesses and event planners further enhance its offerings, making it a sought-after location for both social and corporate events. Through its commitment to excellence, Clarion Hotel Trondheim aspires to be a leading choice for visitors to the region, ensuring that every guest leaves with lasting memories.

Name: Mat & Drikke Gruppen
Company description: Mat & Drikke gruppen ble startet av Pål Gjelseth i 1983 og er i dag driftsselskapet bak restaurantene Louise Restaurant og Bar, Lekter’n, Sorgenfri og Albert Bistro. Gruppen holder til på Aker Brygge i Oslo med våre ca 550.000 besøkende i året og våre ca 400 ansatte. Våre restauranter serverer kvalitetsmåltider og gode opplevelser. Mange av våre interiører gjenspeiler eiernes lange tradisjon for å samle på kunst og historiske gjenstander, og flere av våre konsepter er blitt landemerker på Aker Brygge og i Oslo by.

Name: Quality Hotel Strawberry Arena
Company description: Quality Hotel Strawberry Arena är eventhotellet för de stora ögonblicken och erbjuder lokaler i en unik evenemangsmiljö i Arenastaden Solna, i norra Stockholm.

Name: Røroshotellene
Company description: Røroshotellene is a hospitality group that operates several unique venues in the UNESCO World Heritage town of Røros, including Erzscheidergården, Røros Hotell, and Vertshuset Røros. The company specializes in providing exclusive accommodations and tailored meeting experiences, allowing clients to rent entire hotels for undisturbed gatherings, executive meetings, and events. With a mission to create unforgettable experiences steeped in history and local culture, Røroshotellene aims to combine modern comfort with the charm of Røros' rich heritage. Their target market includes corporate clients, event organizers, and tourists seeking a unique and tranquil setting, complemented by partnerships with local restaurants and activity providers to enhance guest experiences. The company is committed to sustainability and community engagement, ensuring that their services reflect the values and traditions of the Røros region.

Name: Meet Ullevaal
Company description: Meet Ullevaal is a premier event and meeting space located at Ullevaal Stadion, offering a unique and modern environment for various gatherings, including corporate meetings, exhibitions, and banquets. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional experiences through state-of-the-art facilities, including well-equipped meeting rooms, free Wi-Fi, and advanced audio-visual technology. With a mission to create memorable events, Meet Ullevaal aims to cater to the needs of medium-sized groups, ensuring a comfortable and engaging atmosphere. Its clients range from corporate entities to event organizers seeking a distinctive venue, while partnerships with local service providers enhance the overall experience. The target market includes businesses and organizations looking for a versatile space that combines functionality with an inspiring view of the stadium's lush green pitch.

Name: Villa Paradiso
Company description: Villa Paradiso is a charming Italian restaurant located at Lilleborg torg, offering an authentic culinary experience that celebrates the rich flavors of Italy. The restaurant's mission is to create memorable dining experiences through exquisite food and wine pairings, exemplified by events like the Winemakers Dinner featuring wines from the renowned Brangero winery in Piemonte. Guests can indulge in a specially crafted five-course menu by head chef Enrico, complemented by five carefully selected wines, while learning about the traditions and culture of northern Italian winemaking from Marco Brangero himself. Villa Paradiso caters to food and wine enthusiasts looking for a unique dining experience, making it an ideal destination for special occasions or thoughtful gifts. With its intimate setting by the Akerselva, Villa Paradiso aims to transport diners to Italy, creating a magical atmosphere filled with delightful tastes and stories.

Name: Solstrand Hotel & Bad
Company description: Solstrand ligger vakker til ved Bjørnefjorden, kun 30 km fra Bergen og Bergen Lufthavn.  Solstrands fasiliteter består av 135 rom, restaurant, stuer & bar, 25 møterom, SPA- og velværeavdeling, samt en 100 mål vakker hage mot fjorden.  Vi er vertskap for en spennende blanding av lederprogram for næringslivet, rekreasjon, selskapelighet og turisme.

Name: Quality Airport Hotel Gardermoen
Company description: Quality Airport Hotel Gardermoen is a premier accommodation provider located near Oslo Airport, catering to both business and leisure travelers. The hotel is dedicated to delivering exceptional service and comfort, ensuring a pleasant stay for its guests. With a focus on creating memorable experiences, Quality Airport Hotel Gardermoen aims to be the preferred choice for those seeking convenience and quality in their travel arrangements. The hotel serves a diverse clientele, including tourists, corporate groups, and event organizers, and partners with local businesses to enhance guest experiences. Its target market includes travelers looking for easy access to the airport, as well as those seeking venues for conferences, weddings, and other celebrations.

Name: Storfjord Hotel
HQ Location: Norway, Møre Og Romsdal, Ålesund, Øvre Glomset, 6260
Company description: Storfjord Hotel is a premier destination nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of Sunnmøre, Norway, offering guests a unique blend of luxury accommodation and outdoor adventure. The hotel is dedicated to providing an exceptional experience that combines stunning natural beauty with personalized service, aiming to inspire both local and visiting adventurers. With a mission to create memorable stays, Storfjord Hotel offers a variety of hiking opportunities, from leisurely walks to challenging treks, ensuring that every guest can find their perfect outdoor experience. The hotel also features a wellness area and cozy lounges, where guests can unwind after a day of exploration, complemented by a delicious three-course dinner. Targeting nature enthusiasts and those seeking relaxation, Storfjord Hotel partners with local guides to enhance the guest experience, making it an ideal retreat for anyone looking to connect with the majestic fjords and mountains of the region.

Name: Home Hotel 1624
Company description: Clarion Collection Hotel Kongsberg åpnet 1. april. 2022 og er et spektakulært hotell i moderne arkitektur beliggende svært sentralt i sølvbyen og teknologibyen Kongsberg.  Med servicekvalitet, innemiljø, matopplevelser, velvære aktiviteter og historiske opplevelser i særklasse, skal vi gi våre gjester et hotellopphold som gjør at de ønsker å komme tilbake - igjen og igjen. 1624 Restaurant & Bar i 11. etasje, er bokstavelig talt et høydepunkt. Med en utsikt som kan ta pusten fra deg, en utsøkt meny fra det italienske kjøkken og raust med kultur- og underholdningstilbud i byen, skal vi gi våre gjester minneverdige øyeblikk og følelsen av tilhørighet. Alle de 121 rommene på Hotellet har interiør og fasiliteter som appellerer til sansene og inviterer til avslapning. Slappe av, vil gjestene virkelig også få anledning til i den trendy velvære-avdelingen i tredje etasje. Clarion Collection Hotel Kongsberg er også en møteplass for næringsliv og i våre tre moderne Chambre Separee vil vi kunne tilby alle fasiliteter som skal til for å gjennomføre vellykkede møter og selskaper.

Name: Bårdshaug Herregård
Company description: Welcome to Bårdshaug Herregård – a historic manor house and modern hotel ‘right at the heart of Norway’! Bårdshaug’s unique history and traditions of hospitality date all the way back to the early 20th century when it was the residence of the influential entrepreneur Christian Thams. Today’s Bårdshaug consists of the manor house, several charming buildings from Thams’ time and a newer full-service hotel building. Stay the night in one of our six guestrooms in the manor house, and feel the tranquil atmosphere from former times, or enjoy todays comfort in a modern guestroom in the main building.  Our restaurant offers a menu that features homemade, seasonal food using fresh, local produce. During the summer we offer informal talks on local history and guided tours of our historic manor house.

Name: Dalen Hotel
Company description: The Dalen Hotel is known as “the hotel from the fairytales”. It was opened in 1894 in a grand romantic style with dragon heads, towers and spiers, balconys and cornices. Combining a visit to the Dalen Hotel with sailing the Telemark Canal with MS Henrik Ibsen and MS Victoria is a unique historical journey back in time with modern comfort and service. The hotel is open from medio February to medio December. The ships traffic the Telemark Canal on a daily basis from late May to late September. Please contact the hotel for exact dates. We are pleased to welcome you to one of Norway’s oldest wooden hotels, only 400 m from Dalen Pier, the end station of the Telemark Canal with easy access to the hotel.

Name: Hotel Christiania Teater
Company description: We are a small upscale boutique hotel located centrally in Oslo. Only a few steps from the City hall, the Royal Castle, and the Parlament. In the lobby you find Teatro a bar, and on second floor a gourmet pizza restaurant. With over 1500 bottles and 50 of them by glass this is true love. The hotel consists of 102 individually decorated rooms with large double beds perfect for both business and pleasure.

Name: Hotel Norge Kristiansand
Company description: Fredag 1. mai 2020 starter neste kapittel i vår historie.  Navnet Hotel Norge, beliggenheten midt i byen og den gode atmosfæren er uforandret. Utover dette har hele hotellet – inkludert restaurant Dronningen, konferansesalene, rommene, resepsjonen og andre møteplasser – blitt fullstendig oppgradert i en lun og elegant, skandinavisk stil.

Name: Quality Hotel Residence Sandnes
Company description: The hotel is part of a multicentre with shopping mall, hotel and cinema in the same building. This gives you as a guest a large variety of opportunities under one roof. The hotel is located in the centre of Sandnes, 15 min from Stavanger Airport Sola and 15 minutes from the city centre of Stavanger. The Hotel has a shuttle bus to the airport, bus and train station just outside and indoor car parking. Quality Hotel Residence is a full service hotel with spacious and modern rooms, conference and banquet facilities, a la carte restaurant and piano bar Monday to Saturday. Our congress and conference centre offers 1400m2 with stylish and flexible meeting rooms and exhibition areas. We have 2 large meeting rooms with a capacity for up to 350 each, which may also be divided into smaller units. In addition we have group rooms and a boardroom. The cinema halls double as plenary halls during daytime, which is fairly uniq.

Name: Basecamp Explorer Spitsbergen AS
Company description: Welcome to Basecamp Explorer Spitsbergen, your gateway to exceptional experiences on Svalbard. With our renowned destinations, Isfjord Radio Adventure Hotel and the unparalleled Nordenskiöld Lodge, we invite guests to embark on exotic adventures amidst the Arctic wilderness. Isfjord Radio Adventure Hotel, a meticulously renovated radio station dating back to 1933, offers unparalleled comfort just nine miles outside Longyearbyen. In winter, traverse glaciers and tundra, navigate majestic mountains, and cross frozen fjords via snowmobile, dog sled, or skis. In the summer, embark on boat excursions in Isfjorden, surrounded by captivating marine life. Nordenskiöld Lodge stands as the world's northernmost commercial lodge, boasting a prime location in front of the awe-inspiring Nordenskiöld glacier. This rustic gem provides all the comforts of home, offering guests a rare opportunity to immerse themselves in untouched and unique natural surroundings, far removed from civilization. In Longyearbyen, our guests find respite in the historic Basecamp Hotel, inspired by the architecture of Svalbard's trappers cabins and adorned with elements from Arctic research and expeditions. At Basecamp Explorer Spitsbergen, we pride ourselves on our reputation for tailoring exceptional experiences. Our knowledgeable and dedicated team is committed to showcasing the unparalleled beauty of Svalbard, focusing on intricate details that transform moments into soulful and exclusive experiences.

Name: Clarion Hotel Oslo
Company description: Clarion Hotel Oslo is a premier hospitality establishment located in the heart of Norway's capital, dedicated to providing a blend of comfort and modern amenities. The hotel focuses on delivering exceptional service and creating memorable experiences for its guests, whether they are traveling for business or leisure. With a strong commitment to sustainability and local culture, Clarion Hotel Oslo aims to be a welcoming space that reflects the vibrant spirit of the city. Its diverse clientele includes both domestic and international travelers, corporate groups, and event organizers, making it a versatile choice for various occasions. The hotel partners with local businesses and cultural institutions to enhance guest experiences and promote community engagement, further enriching the stay for visitors. Clarion Hotel Oslo combines modern luxury with historical charm, offering guests a unique experience in a beautifully preserved setting. The establishment is well-known for its quality dining options, including a delightful three-course dinner and a lavish breakfast, catering to couples, families, and business travelers alike. The venue is also well-suited for events, accommodating up to 90 guests in its elegant ballroom, making it a popular choice for celebrations and corporate gatherings. The hotel's mission is to ensure that every guest feels pampered and at home, while its vision is to be a premier destination for those seeking both relaxation and recreation in a picturesque environment. Through its commitment to quality and innovation, Clarion Hotel Oslo strives to be a leader in the hospitality industry, ensuring that every stay is enjoyable and enriching.

Name: Clarion Collection Hotel With
Company description: Clarion Collection Hotel With is located downtown Tromsø facing the sea and the mountains. We offer breakfast and evening buffet FREE of charge!! Our guests can also enjoy coffee for free. Welcome to our great hotel ranked as no 2 i Tromsø at TripAdvisor.com

Name: Sundvolden Hotel
Company description: Sundvolden Hotel is a privately owned and operated establishment located by Tyrifjorden in Buskerud, Norway, currently managed by Tord and Cecilie Laeskogen, who represent the second generation of the Laeskogen family to run the hotel. With a commitment to providing exceptional hospitality, the hotel has undergone significant upgrades and investments, totaling over a quarter of a billion kroner, to enhance its facilities and expand its capacity. The Laeskogens prioritize creating memorable experiences for their guests, focusing on sustainability through energy efficiency, local food sourcing, and community engagement. Their clientele includes both leisure and business travelers, and they collaborate with local suppliers to ensure a sustainable approach to hospitality. Sundvolden Hotel aims to be a leader in environmental responsibility while fostering a welcoming atmosphere for all visitors.

Name: Unike Hoteller
Company description: Unike Hoteller specializes in creating a dignified and serene environment for memorial services, offering dedicated spaces where clients can personalize decorations to honor their loved ones. The company provides a range of catering options, including various menus featuring warm sandwiches, homemade cakes, and traditional Afternoon Tea, all served in a tranquil setting complemented by soothing background music. Unike Hoteller aims to deliver exceptional service and memorable experiences, making it a preferred choice for families and organizations seeking to commemorate special occasions. Their target market includes individuals planning memorials, weddings, and other significant events, as well as corporate clients looking for conference and catering services. Through partnerships with local suppliers and a commitment to quality, Unike Hoteller strives to create unique and personalized experiences for every guest.

Name: Finse 1222 AS
Company description: Norway's highest situated hotel only accessible by train, skis/foot or bike.  The hotel has 43 rooms and 120 beds and has seasonal opening from new year until late May and from early July until early October. The hotel has an extensive history from its establishment in 1909 and is today family owned and part of the Historic hotels of Norway

Name: Up Norway
Company description: Up Norway introduces discerning travelers to authentic and immersive experiences. The combination of local expertise, a sustainable approach, passion for Norway, and digital itineraries enrich the experience of each unique guest. Up Norway is proud to be B Corp-certified, a recognition of long-term sustainability efforts and corporate social responsibility leadership. We are also a Condé Nast Top Travel Specialist and a Travel + Leisure Top Travel Advisor. Up Norway commits to operating in a way that has a significant positive impact on its community and environment and has sourced partners who share these core values. Through providing guests with authentic experiences and offering exclusive access to sites and insider stories that would be a challenge to discover otherwise, Up Norway commits to providing “best ever” experiences.

Name: Soria Moria Hotell
Company description: Soria Moria Hotell er fjellhotellet i byen. Vi har 25 møterom i alle størrelser, fra små styrerom til vår største plenumssal som kan romme opptil 300 mennesker. Her finnes det 156 moderne gjesterom, restaurant og rooftop-bar som ble pusset opp i 2018. Til hotellet hører Askeladdens Hus, et laftet tømmerbygg som kun benyttes av en gruppe av gangen. Askeladdens Hus har fem møterom, vinkjeller, restaurant og kjøkken, og er det ypperste stedet for spesielle anledninger.  Vi har 35 års erfaring med kurs, konferanse og selskap, og skreddersyr arrangementer etter gjestenes ønsker.  Soria Moria Hotell ligger 500 meter over havet, med fantastisk utsikt og nærhet til naturen. Her finnes 180 parkeringsplasser mot avgift og 12 ladestasjoner til EL-bil. Velkommen til en eventyrlig opplevelse! HISTORIE År 1900 sto Voksenkollen Sanatorium klart til å ta imot sine gjester og pasienter på Oslos tak. Blant de som besøkte sanatoriet ofte var komponisten Edvard Grieg, og han kalte det sitt Soria Moria slott. I 1919 brant  den vakre bygningen til grunnen under mistenkelige omstendigheter. Var det en brannpåsettelse motivert av forsikringssvindel? En gjest ble tiltalt for mordbrann, men etter en omfattende politietterforskning ble saken henlagt av mangel på bevis. Brannen forble et mysterium.  Den norske legeforeningen kjøpte branntomten på slutten av 1970-tallet, og bygde Soria Moria Hotell ferdig i 1983. Hotellet har senere blitt modernisert og utvidet i flere omganger. Det nyeste tilskuddet er Askeladdens Hus. Dette er en 1200 kvm stor tømmerhytte, som er forbundet til hotellet gjennom en 35 meter lang underjordisk tunnel. Askeladdens Hus brukes ofte til bryllup og selskaper grunnet sine romantiske lokaler og flotte beliggenhet. Bygningen er preget av kunstneren Theodor Kittelsen sin forestilling om Soria Moria – håpet – som blinker i det fjerne.  Soria Moria tar miljø på alvor, og har siden 2001 vært godkjent som Miljøfyrtårn.

Name: Ps Hotel By Nordic Choice
Company description: ps:hotel by Nordic Choice is an extraordinary hotel with ordinary guests.  We employ people who have fallen outside the ordinary work life. Together we provide the skill set and experience needed to get back on track. Staying with us makes you a co-creator of social innovation, where inclusion and sustainable solutions makes for a better world. Uniquely ordinary. We pride ouselves on being a flagship of sustainability. Great location, great coffee, and great people gives this hotel it's character. Our passion is to provide training to people who need a way back to work.

Name: De Historiske Hotel & Spisesteder
Company description: De Historiske - Historic Hotels & Restaurants is a unique membership organisation containing many of Norway’s most charming hotels and restaurants. The group consists of 62 hotels, 24 restaurants and 1 historic ship. Our aim is to use the past as a backdrop for our guests, to enable them to create their own history based on experiences. It is our hope that these narrations may continue to live in the memories of our guests long after their return home. Although the members of De Historiske each have their own distinctive characters, you will find that they have features in common: a warm welcome, good service, a friendly atmosphere and high quality in every respect. The quality standards that the group has in common ensure a generally high standard in the group, and our values of ”hospitable”, ”personal” and ”quality conscious” shall aid us in achieving our shared vision: we want visitors to find us ”a good place to be”. Delicious meals and vintage wines, beautiful art and culture, design and decor based on deeply-rooted tradition and history, elegance, exciting tales, a romantic atmosphere and much more can be experienced without leaving the hotels. Golf, sleigh rides, ski trails, fjords, waterfalls, fishing, hunting, boating, mountain tops, museums, shopping, horse riding, walking tours and many other activities are there to tempt you right outside your door.

Name: Clarion Hotel Draken
Company description: Clarion Hotel® Draken är en mötesplats genomsyrad av gastronomi, musik och kultur.

Name: Engø Gård
Company description: Begynnelsen til det som i dag er Engø Gård, var Pihls Pensjonat – et av Tjømes mange sommerpensjonater.  Det var romantikeren Frithjof Pihl og hans søster Daisy som åpnet pensjonat på Engø i 1924.  Frithjofs engelske kone Babs tilførte stedet britisk charm og eleganse. Den samme atmosfæren henger igjen og betegnes av mange som "Engø feelingen". i dag er Engø Gård Hotel & Restaurant et landlig hotell med anerkjent gourmetrestaurant. Det serveres frokost, lunsj, afternoon tea og 4-7 retters gourmet meny hele året. Bord kan bestilles til alle måltider selv uten overnatting på hotellet. Engø Gård har også flotte konferanse lokaler, selskapslokaler og et fantastisk område - det er også mulig å leie hele gården eksklusivt,  inkludert alle de 47 hotellrommene og andre lokaler. Det er populært brukt til eventer, ledersamlinger, bursdagsfeiringer og bryllup Hjertelig velkommen til oss!  Team Engø Gård

Name: Malangen Resort
Company description: This modern, purpose-built resort has an idyllic waterfront location on the picturesque Malangen Peninsula, just an hour’s drive from Tromsø, the largest city in Northern Norway. During the winter season, we aim to be the leading Northern Lights resort in the Tromsø region, providing complete solutions involving transport, accommodation, dining and Northern Lights adventures. This is the perfect place for business or pleasure, offering a unique combination of fjord and mountain and everything needed for a memorable stay within easy walking distance. Accommodation is available in a choice of hotel room, apartment, sea-view cabin, deluxe sea-view cabin or deluxe waterfront cabin – all offering a high standard of quality and comfort and spectacular views. Our restaurant specialises in North Norwegian cuisine made from fresh, locally sourced ingredients. Malangen Resort has a total of 86 accommodation units and can accommodate up to 360 guests

Name: Hotel Oleana
Company description: Colourful. Bold. Passionate. Celebrating all the senses. Hotel Oleana is inspired by Ole Bull, a violinist, composer and international superstar born only a stone’s throw from the hotel. Hotel Oleana offers 97 tailor-made rooms, 3 meeting rooms, and our own restaurant. With us you get homemade food and refreshing drinks, in addition to great service and a unique atmosphere. This is also a popular meeting place, and simply a must for adventurous cocktail lovers.

Name: Quality Hotel Edvard Grieg
Company description: Quality Hotel Edvard Grieg is a premier hotel located in Norway, dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality and a memorable experience for its guests. The hotel aims to create a welcoming atmosphere where comfort and quality service are paramount, catering to both leisure and business travelers. With a focus on Norwegian traditions, the hotel offers a variety of dining experiences, including festive events like Christmas parties and lutefisk evenings, showcasing local culinary delights. Its target market includes families, corporate clients, and event organizers looking for versatile spaces for celebrations and gatherings. Quality Hotel Edvard Grieg partners with local artists and culinary experts to enhance its offerings, ensuring that every guest enjoys a unique and enriching stay.

Name: Fredriksten Hotell
Company description: Fredriksten Hotell ligger i fantastiske omgivelser på historiske Fredriksten festning i Halden.  Enten du ønsker å overnatte i flotte, historiske omgivelser, eller benytte en særpreget arena for ditt møte eller konferanse, er Fredriksten Hotell et godt valg. Her er det i århundrer blitt utkjempet viktige slag og sluttført harde forhandlinger. Den historiske rammen på Fredriksten gir inspirasjon for veien videre. Hos oss kombineres et hyggelig opphold gjerne med et historisk innhold. Vi arrangerer gjerne en historisk vandring på Fredriksten festning for ditt selskap.

Name: Kragerø Resort
Company description: Kragerø Resort har en særpreget arkitektur, interiør og design. Med Kragerøs fantastiske skjærgård som nærmeste nabo kan resorten oppleves som «et lite stykke Sørlandet». Kragerø Resort ligger majestetisk plassert med storslagen utsikt på Stabbestad. Du har et unikt utgangspunkt for et velfortjent avbrekk fra hverdagens stress og mas hos oss. Kragerø Resort er mer enn bare rom til leie. Hotellet har et 1700 mål stort opplevelsesområde, med spa-anlegg, tennisbaner, en av Norges flotteste golfbaner, beach club, kajakker, beachvolleybane, konferansesenter, restauranter, variert turområde og et omfattende aktivitetstilbud i hele Kragerø distriktet.

Name: Clarion Hotel Air
Company description: Clarion Hotel Air is a premier hotel located in Norway, offering a blend of comfort and modern amenities for both leisure and business travelers. The hotel is dedicated to providing exceptional service and creating memorable experiences for its guests, aligning with its mission to be a leader in the hospitality industry. With a focus on quality dining and event hosting, Clarion Hotel Air caters to a diverse clientele, including families, corporate groups, and individuals seeking a relaxing getaway. The hotel partners with local businesses and artists to enhance its offerings, ensuring a unique and culturally rich experience for all visitors. Its target market includes both domestic and international travelers looking for a welcoming atmosphere and top-notch facilities.

Name: Quality Hotel River Station
HQ Location: Norway, Buskerud, Drammen, 7 Doktor Hansteins Gate, 3044
Company description: Welcome to Quality Hotel™ River Station - perfectly located by Drammen Station.  The hotel is right next to the river in Drammen, within one minute from the train station and in the urban and growing area Strømsø. It takes just 35 minutes to reach Oslo Central Station from here. You can also get to Oslo Airport Gardermoen in only 58 minutes! The hotel features 13 floors, 247 rooms, 8 meeting rooms, a large hall of 400 square metres, a modern fitness room, a bar Sidespor and two restaurants. Quality Hotel River Station is Drammen's tallest building, adorning the riverside and city skyline. The city bridge near the hotel will connect you to Bragernes Square in just five minutes, where you'll find Aass brewery, Norway's oldest brewery that is still in operation. Drammen will give you several restaurants, great shopping and and why not go for aa walk along the river promenade. It’s the little things that make your stay with us special. Like the waitress who offers homemade pastries. The housekeeper who leaves you hand written welcome notes. Or the receptionist that treats your five-year-old like a queen. At Quality Hotel, we care genuinely about our guests. We care about every conference booker and do everything to make their event run as smoothly as possible. And we love to spoil tired parents and make kids happy when they spend their weekend together. Our 60+ hotels across the Nordics all have their own setting and character, but they all share the same warm and light-hearted atmosphere. Because at Quality Hotel we believe that showing true personality is the key to making each guest’s experience amazing. One fun fact: the local name of the hotels is "Brunosten".The locals have named the hotel after the famous norwegian brown cheese, because it reminds them of the this famous brown cheese. We would love to se you soon!

Name: HEIMR Collection
Company description: HEIMR Collection is a dynamic hospitality group that operates a portfolio of 12 distinctive hotels, along with several restaurants and bars under its own brand names. Established in 2018, the company has rapidly expanded its presence across Norway, taking over notable properties from Farsund in the south to Mosjøen in the north. With a mission to deliver exceptional guest experiences, HEIMR Collection focuses on creating unique atmospheres that reflect the character of each location. The company is committed to growth, aiming for a revenue of approximately 800 million NOK by 2024, and is backed by Glastad Holding. Its target market includes both leisure and business travelers seeking high-quality accommodations and services in some of Norway's most beautiful destinations.

Name: Søstrene Storaas Hotell
Company description: Søstrene Storaas Hotell ligger idyllisk plassert ved foten av Blefjell utenfor Kongsberg. Skjermet fra omverdenen, med mye plass og med en nydelig natur rett utenfor vinduet. Hotellet er endel av De Historiske Restauranter og Spisesteder og fokuserer på kortreiste matprodukter og storytelling.

Name: Quality Hotel Olavsgaard
Company description: Quality Hotel Olavsgaard is a premier venue specializing in creating unforgettable wedding experiences tailored to each couple's unique vision. With a mission to bring dream weddings to life, the hotel offers a comprehensive wedding package that includes personalized planning, exquisite dining options, and elegant event spaces. Their dedicated team, led by experienced staff like the head waiter Lisbeth, ensures that every detail is meticulously arranged, from menu selection to decor, allowing couples to focus on celebrating their special day. The hotel features multiple beautifully appointed wedding venues, accommodating various guest sizes, and provides comfortable overnight accommodations for both the couple and their guests. Quality Hotel Olavsgaard aims to deliver exceptional service and memorable experiences, making it a favored choice for couples looking to celebrate their love in a stunning setting.

Name: Hotel Union Øye
HQ Location: Norway, Møre Og Romsdal, Norangsfjorden, 41 Norangsdal, 6196
Company description: In the secluded fjord hamlet of Øye, a hotelier jewel from the olden times, when traveling meant introspective discovery, long days of reading and hiking adventures in tweed. It has been a place where visitors come to savor the good life and the tranquility in magnificent surroundings since 1891. As you take in the ambience you will be amazed by the historical facts surrounding each the individually designed rooms. They are all named after the notables who have stayed here; we hope you will be inspired by all those famous writers, mountaineers, artists and royals you will hear and read about. Enjoy a meal in the beautiful dining room and listen to old exciting stories from other eras, shared by the fireplace after dinner. The bed where you’ll sleep, is truly fit for a King or Queen - we know because it has been so. Proud member of: Relais & Chateaux De Historiske

Name: Ophelix Scandinavia
Company description: Award-winning, scandinavian chain for DMC, meetings and events. We can help you with everything: flight- and hotel booking, entertainment,  planning of locations, program and logistics, new concepts and ideas... you name it! Get in touch, and We will make it happen!

Name: Workzilla
Company description: Workzilla is the company that helps you find and book amazing places to work from.

Name: Oscarsborg Festning
Company description: Oscarsborg Festning is a historic site in Norway, renowned for its pivotal role in the nation's history, particularly during World War II. The fortification gained prominence on the night of April 9, 1940, when the cruiser Blücher was sunk in Drøbaksundet, delaying the German invasion of Oslo and allowing the Norwegian government and royal family to evacuate. The site is not only a testament to Norway's military history but also serves as a cultural hub, recently hosting the premiere of the film "Blücher," which dramatizes these historical events. With a mission to preserve and promote Norway's rich heritage, Oscarsborg Festning attracts a diverse audience, including history enthusiasts, filmmakers, and the local community. The fortification collaborates with various partners in the film industry and cultural sectors to bring historical narratives to life, ensuring that the stories of courage and responsibility are shared with future generations.

Name: Sørmarka Konferansehotell
Company description: Sørmarka er et moderne konferansehotell som ligger vakkert og landlig til, kun 20 minutter fra Oslo, Tusenfryd og Ski. Som profesjonelt konferansehotell har vi høyt fokus på kvalitet og god service. De tekniske løsninger er tilpasset dagens behov. Restaurant Bjørk serverer en rikholdig lunsjbuffét, og Gildesalen er perfekt til selskap. Hotellet har 133 hotellrom.  Sørmarka Events tilbyr ulike typer teambuilding og aktiviteter. Dette er populært blant våre konferansegjester. Med egen Gapahuk, á la carte restaurant, flott nyoppusset lobbybar og store utearealer legger vi til rette for at deres arrangement blir en opplevelse utenom det vanlige. Alle våre gjester har gratis parkering, og her er mulighet for å lade EL-bil.

Name: Hem
Company description: After demand from customers Hem was founded in 2017. With Hem, business travelers, expats and corporate accommodation bookers can request and book serviced apartments for long term business trips or for any relocation needs. Hem is developed by Sure! in partnership with Frogner House Apartments.

Name: Quality Hotel Sogndal
Company description: Ingen reiser uinspirert frå konferanse på Quality Hotel™ Sogndal. Vi ligg tett på naturopplevelsane, har topp moderne møtesalar og tre restaurantar. Din neste konferanse blir din beste. Når appetitten vekkes, står våre tre restaurantar klare med delikate rettar som spenner frå heimelaga rettar basert på lokale råvarer til italienske retter med den ekte smaken frå Italia og sist men ikkje minst trendy og smaksrike burgere. Her finn du nydeleg mat og god drikke i fantastiske lokaler - du er velkommen! Baren er den rette staden å være dersom du feirar ein avgjerande deal, tar samtalen vidare etter lang tids brainstorming, eller berre vil slå av ein prat. Kanskje treng du ein utfordring? Då står vårt Shuffleboard klar for ein match.  Og er du ute på vift, kan Lounge 24 sin døgnopne service være tingen, her kan natteravnar når som helst sjekke inn for ein snack eller ein drink. For dei av oss som hevdar at avkobling er synonymt med å brenne kaloriar, har vi eit treningssenter med topp moderne utstyr, og som er open frå tidlig på morgonen til seint på kvelden. Eller kvifor ikkje ta ein rusle eller joggetur på Fjordstien gjennom Sogndal med vakker fjordutsikt til Sognefjorden. For meetings that matter. Hos oss er det møtet som er viktigst. Møtet mellom to kollegaer som inspirerar kvarandre til ein ny, brilliant idé saman, og møtet der hundre jobbkompiser plutseleg delar samme visjon. Møtet mellom oss og deg. Augeblinket som verkeleg betyr noko. På vårt hotell har vi 226 rom i ei rekkje ulike størrelsar, 9 fleksible møtelokaler med plass til opptil 507 personar, dei vakre omgjevnadane og vårt team med møterådgivere - og kva får du? Eit inspirerande og ein særs praktisk stad å gjere forretningar på, dele idear og knytte forbindelsar.

Name: Sorrisniva AS
Company description: Sorrisniva offers guests a true Arctic experience with accommodation in the premium Arctic Wilderness Lodge or Igloo Hotel, renowned local cuisine, and a wide range of nature experiences throughout the dramatically different Arctic seasons

Company description: Byens største hotell med fantastisk utsikt over smedasundet, som tilbyr 311 rom og suiter, store og små konferansefasiliteter og 4 restauranter midt i hjertet av Haugesund.

Name: Smarthotel
Company description: Smarthotel er en norsk prisvennlig hotellkjede som har hoteller sentralt i seks norske byer. Vårt konsept er å tilby overnatting i en smart innpakning av høy kvalitet. Hjertelig velkommen til Smarthotel

Company description: En lokal medlemsforening i DNT som strekkes seg fra Hardangervidda i nord til Hurumlandet i sør med ca 11.000 medlemmer.

Name: Norsk Tindesenter
Company description: Norsk Tindesenter (Norwegian Mountaineering Centre) is a brand new visitor and activity centre located in the stunning township of Åndalsnes, Romsdal.  Norsk Tindesenter has a museum, climbing centre, cafe/restaurant, souvenirshop and via ferrata.  We offer a wide range of guided activites both out- and indoors. Join us for an adventure today! Visitors from all over the world are drawn to the Romsdal region by its outstanding natural beauty. The fjords , mountains and proximity to several large norwegian national parks, makes Åndalsnes the ultimate base for outdoor activities.  World famous tourist attractions like Trollstigen, Trollveggen, Raumabanen (Europes most scenic train ride) and Romsdalseggen are all  within proximity. In the wintertime you can enjoy world class skitouring terrain from sea to summit. That is our best kept secret if you prefer the unbeaten track!

Name: Hard Rock Cafe Oslo
Company description: The first Hard Rock Cafe (HRC) opened its doors  to the public on June 14, 1971, in London, England. Founded by Isaac Tigrett and Peter Morton, two enterprising and music-loving Americans, HRC was an instant classic, attracting droves of customers with its first-rate, but moderately priced casual American fare, warm service and ever-present rock 'n' roll music and sensibility. Although it was initially decorated with an eye toward eclectic Americana, HRC has ultimately become the world's leading collector and exhibitors of rock 'n' roll memorabilia.

Name: Tyrifjord Hotell
Company description: "Ikke for stort - ikke for lite". Hotell, konferansested og restauranthus. Tyrifjord Hotell er et fullservice hotell med 64 værelser og 196 senger i Vikersund, midt i Buskerud, idyllisk beliggenhet ved Tyrifjorden med privat strand og marina - midt mellom Drammen, Kongsberg og Hønefoss, kun 60 minutter fra Oslo og 20 minutter fra Hokksund og Hønefoss. Gratis parkering. Her finner du moderne kurs -og konferansefasiliteter, restaurant, et kreativt og spennende kjøkken og en hyggelig, fleksibel atmosfære, der gjestene vies full oppmerksomhet. Hotellets idylliske og landlige beliggenhet ved Tyrifjorden danner en hyggelig ramme ved gjennomføring av kurs og konferanser, feiring av bryllup, jubiléer, julebord, bedriftsarrangementer og selskaper. Hotellet ligger ved sundplassen Østre Vikersund der løytnant Johan Sommer og hans kone Lisbeth Hansdatter Erfings bygget gjestgiveriet Østsundet rundt 1665. Det gamle gjestgiveriet ble flyttet til Drammens Museum i 1990, men gjestgivertradisjonen lever videre i dag - om enn i en noe mer moderne innpakning.

Name: Kleivstua
Company description: Kleivstua Hotell er et flott og populært konferansehotell med storslagen beliggenhet kun 45 km fra Oslo. Kleivstua består av 18 hus med totalt 42 værelser. Husene er bygget opp og restaurert etter alle gamle kunsters regler. Kleivstua er historie, tradisjon og skogsmysterier. Kleivstua er et sted for gode møter mellom mennesker – både de som snakker forretninger, gifter seg eller har noe å feire.

Name: Funken Lodge
Company description: We are delighted to welcome you to Funken Lodge, our oasis in the Arctic wilderness. We know that you will quickly realise why this hotel has become a favourite with visitors to Svalbard. The atmosphere in the hotel invites you to sink your shoulders after a day of outdoor experiences. Relax in a cosy chair in front of the fireplace, and retrace the steps of Polar heroes in a book from our library. Or perhaps one of our signature cocktails from Funken Bar?  All of the rooms and public areas are delightfully furnished, and our friendly team help to create the perfect stay. If the hotel's walls could speak, they would share stories of both elegant and boisterous gatherings under the coal mining heydays, of Champagne tastings in det Gamle Nordpolet, and fascinating discussions held in the salons. The hotel has been a home away from home for both royals and heads of state, and has kept its renommé from when it was home to the mining company's office staff.  New histories and tall tales are ready to be told - and remembered by the hotel's walls - welcome to Funken Lodge!

Because the hotel is located 2km away from the center of Geiranger, you can feel peace and quiet and distance yourself from the crowds and use our complimentary private shuttle or electric cars when going back and forth. The hotel was built in 1996, however it has been refurnished and renovated in 2018. With 46 guest rooms and 91 beds, many of our rooms are facing the fjord and many with private balcony. We equip all rooms with Wonderland Superior beds, refrigerator, Nespresso coffee machine, telephone, flat screen TV, Acqua di Parma toiletries and a Dyson bladeless fan for cooling and heating. Our doorman and bellhop are always ready to take care of luggage and assist with parking. Our guests are also able to use our Fitness Center and Jacuzzi as well as our laundry room free of charge.

Vi tar mål av oss å være et foretrukket valg av overnattingssted når du kommer til Tromsø. Siden åpningen i 2000 har vi opparbeidet oss mange stamgjester, som kommer tilbake til oss igjen og igjen. Noe som gjør oss sikker på at vi som et kjedefritt hotell gjør tingene riktig.

Name: Play SHUFL.
Company description: Play SHUFL. is the largest and only specialist shuffleboard brand bringing an inclusive and memorable competitive socialising experience to pubs, bars, office and leisure destinations across the world. We install handcrafted shuffleboard tables that feature our unique curved playing surface adding an entirely new dimension to the game, extending the fun for hours. Shuffleboard is a great way to offer customers a new experience, boost visits to a venue and increase bar sales. Our expertise in this competitive pub game and our ability to deliver bespoke business solutions, means we’ve established ourselves as the leading shuffleboard specialists. Our player interaction through events and shuffleboard tournaments, fuels awareness of the game and establishes a loyal customer base around locations that house SHUFL. tables. Part of European Shuffleboard, the number one premium shuffleboard supplier in Europe since 2009, SHUFL. installs tables in Norway, Sweden, Germany, Denmark, Switzerland, Australia and the UK.

Company description: Nores er en innkjøpsorganisasjon for hoteller og restauranter i Norge og Sverige. Name: General Hotell
Company description: General Hotel is a small, family-run, conference hotel situated in a green area just south of Hønefoss, Norway. In our location you are 1 hour away from "everything"; OSL Gardermoen Airport, Oslo city center, Drammen, Kongsberg and Valdres. The hotel is close to the river Storelva and there is only a 10 minute drive to the vast forests of Nordmarka en Krogskogen. The Norwegian Army has had a camp in Helgelandsmoen since 1869 - hence our name. In 2004 the area was sold to private investors and in 2009 we opened General Hotel. Our last extension came in 2011.  As humans we are helpful, personal, in-formal and precise in our work.  Our kitchen is international - with French roots. The hotel also has an a la carte Italian trattoria.  Our building is typical modern Scandinavian design. In 2011 we built new conference halls which is tasetfully decorated and well equipped with modern technology. The guest rooms were new in 2009 and are both practical and comfortable - in line with today's demand.   Ringeriksbadet, Galleri Klevjer and M/S Dronning Tyra are our good neighbors that many of our guest visit. We also help our clients plan an adopt other activities as relatively newly established - we can also compete on pricing!

Name: Panorama Hotell & Resort
Company description: PANORAMA HOTELL & RESORT Forland, 5379 Steinsland 56 31 90 00		 post@panoramahotell.no	 Panorama Hotell og Resort er et moderne fjordhotell ute i havgapet på Sotra, bare 45 minutters kjøretur fra Bergen sentrum. Her kan du nyte lekker lokal mat, prøve ølsmaking i vårt mikrobryggeri, få spennende opplevelser og aktiviteter, eller bare slappe av i badstuen og nyte livet i utendørs boblebad. Alt med en slående vakker utsikt i bakgrunnen. Hotellet har en fantastisk beliggenhet med utsikt over Korsfjorden og innseilingen til Bergen. Hotellet har et unikt design som er inspirert av lokal kystkultur, presentert på en moderne og nyskapende måte. Aktiviteter er et viktig satsingsområde for oss, og vi tilbyr bl.a. teamkonkurransen Camp Panorama, SUP-brett, kajakkutleie, coasteering, teambuilding og selvsagt RIB-tur og båtutleie. Vi har 16 juniorsuiter og 8 rorbusuiter, samt 5 konferanserom med plass til 5-650 personer. I vår storstue Panoramasalen kan vi rigge til alt fra julebord og bryllup til messer og konserter.  1.mai 2013 overtok vi driften av det kjente landemerket Marsteinen Fyr. Fyret er renovert i 2010 og har 22 sengeplasser samt mulighet for servering og konferanse. Vi tilbyr alt i fra konferansepakker med overnatting til private selskap med et minimumsantall på 8 personer. Transporten ut går fra hotellet med RIB-båter eller helikopter.

Name: Voksenåsen Kultur Og Konferansehotell
Company description: Voksenåsen er Norges nasjonalgave til Sverige, som takk for den humanitære hjelpen under andre verdenskrig. Det er heleid av den svenske stat og huser i dag et kultursenter og et hotell med unike rammer for mellommenneskelige møter.  Voksenåsen er et modernistisk kulturminne midt i naturen, med panoramautsikt over Oslo. Formspråket er tidstypisk med rene linjer, horisontalitet i volumene og store vindusflater. Karakteristiske materialer er hvitslemmet murstein, kobber, tjæret tre, naturstein og eik. Voksenåsen har gjennomgått flere endringer, ombygginger og tilbygg siden innvielse i 1960. Da en av de opprinnelige arkitektene, Hans Kjell Larsen, ledet dette arbeidet, er alle endringer og tilbygg i anleggets ånd. Hotellet har 84 hotellrom og én suite - alle med utsikt over de vakre omgivelsene. Generøse fellesområder inviterer til samvær og restauranten tilbyr både selskapsmeny og à la carte. Lyse og moderne møterom har plass for grupper på opp til 180 personer. Kultursenterets oppdrag er å, i samarbeid med relevante fagmiljøer i Norge og Sverige, drive kontaktskapende virksomhet innen samfunnsliv, språk og kultur. Hovedvekten ligger på kreative, grenseoverskridende læringsarenaer for ungdom. Voksenåsen Musikkakademier og Hågkomstresor for svenske skoleklasser er kultursenterets to største prosjekter innen dette feltet. I umiddelbar nærhet til eiendommen ligger Nordmarka med turstier og sykkelveier om sommeren, samt milevis med skiløyper og skispor om vinteren. I perioden Juni til september kan man som gjest benytte seg kostnadsfritt av utebassenget. Innen gangavstand fra Voksenåsen finner man Roseslottet, som er en unik kunstopplevelse.  Det er 10 km fra Voksenåsen til byen, og 700 meter til Voksenkollen T-banestasjon. Voksenåsen AS er en svensk statlig virksomhet og eies gjennom kulturdepartementet. Statens konstråd er ansvarlig for kunstsamlingen. Eiendommen eies og forvaltes av Statens fastighetsverk.

Name: Stad Hotell
Company description: Stad Hotell er eit sjarmerandes hotell med ei rik historie knytt til livet ved storhavet. Hotellet ligg heilt i fjøra, tett på naturen og naturkreftene. Vi har vakre strender og storslått natur som næraste nabo. Bygd av lokale fiskarar, skil hotellet vårt seg ut med sin unike karakter og sjarm som er heilt sin eigen. Frå du går inn døra på gamle Furebuda, til du legg deg i senga er du omgitt av gammal og nyare fiskerihistorie. Hotellet er bygd og eigd av Ervik havfiske. Ervik havfiske er eit av verdas største linebåt rederi.  I restauranten vår får du servert måltida heilt i sjøkanten.  Her kan du velje om du vil nyte maten i ei varm og koseleg atmosfære i Longline, ei restaurert sjø bod frå 1913, eller i vår nye og moderne Rockall frå 2021. Lokala ligg i tilknyting til kvarandre, men er mogleg å separere dei ved ulike arrangement. Rockall vart bygd som ei utviding av restauranten, men fungera også som selskapslokale og bar i tillegg til restaurant. Kokkane våre er opptekne av å skape gode mat opplevingar. Dei brukar so langt det let seg gjere lokale råvarer. Kortreist og berekraft er viktig, og vi er stolte av å vere godkjende som fiskemottak. Dagens fangst blir henta på kaia vår og rett inn på kjøkkenet, stort meir kortreist enn dette er det vel ikkje mogleg å få det. Om vår lokale fiskar ikkje klarer å levere stort nok kvantum, supplerer vi med fisk frå Ervik Havfiske. Her får vi førsteklasses råvarer fiska med line. Linefiske er ein miljøvennleg måte å drive fiske på.

There is a  camping area and various types of accommodation for up to 80 people. Ideal for weddings, company gatherings, families and larger groups. We specialize in seafood cooking and work along side some of Norways leading chefs, therefore full-board (with prior booking) is also available.

Name: Arendal Herregaard Spa & Resort
Company description: SUSTAINABILITY IS THE FUTURE Sustainability is the future, and for us who cook, it is only natural to think about resource use at all levels. We have a high proportion of renewable materials, we focus on near-traveled raw materials, and are now entering a time where we are looking at reducing meat consumption. This is an excellent place to start without radically interfering with guests' eating habits. The goal is to cut down on the amount of meat in dishes, or to try to find full-fledged substitute products. VALUABLE FOOD WINNING We are working continuously to reduce food waste. The Horeca industry is currently responsible for over 20% of all food waste. This is a child of the heart for us. We believe that food waste can be combated at all levels, and this is one of our measures to limit the "throwing culture". GIVE SOMEONE AN OPPORTUNITY With workers from many different nations, we build a social culture that is about interaction. OUR FOCUS AREAS: Reduction of meat, minimal wastage by integrating leftovers, profits and returns into the daily menu. Environmentally friendly transport, return of all waste and sorting for reuse and recycling, reduction of plastic in packaging. Arendal Herregaard Spa & Resort is working towards becoming Eco-Lighthouse certified during the first quarter of 2020. QUALITY AT ALL LEVELS WE WANT TO DELIVER THE BEST POSSIBLE FOOD, but also at a competitive price. Of course, good food made from scratch requires good ingredients, and we are very aware of what we use. We have a long-term relationship of trust with our suppliers, and we know that we have access to the best raw materials at all times. This means that our chefs can spend their working day producing tasty dishes of the highest quality every single day. With time for better craftsmanship, the taste and quality of the food also improves. GOOD LOCAL PRODUCERS MEAN EVERYTHING Over time, we have found very GOOD PARTNERS in some of the district's finest and best suppliers.

Vi har en lang tradisjon som vertskap for internasjonale og offentlige arrangementer. Denne erfaringen har gitt byens gode rykte som vertskapsby. Den varme og vennlige atmosfæren, gjestfriheten og entusiasmen, kombinert med vakre omgivelser, gjør det spesielt for seilskutene å komme til Bergen. Med de største og vakreste seilskutene i verden liggende til kai, og vår målbindende natur som bakteppe, skal vi over fire sommerdager kaste lys på viktige temaer som samhold, miljø og toleranse. Lokale delikatesser, fengslende kulturinnslag, aktiviteter og praktfull musikk skal prege byen vår. De brosteinsbelagte gatene våre skal smykkes opp med parader og opplevelser i enestående bergensstil. Fra morgen til kveld skal vi sammen forføre tilreisende og de makeløse skipene med vår egen Statsraad Lehmkuhl i spissen. Vi, Bergens befolkning, skal spille hverandre gode og hånd i hånd skal vi skape en folkefest du sent vil glemme.

Til sammen kan de tilby deg det meste av det du ser etter. Alle plukket ut av en grunn. Alle er forskjellige. Eiendommen består av et stort hovedhus med møtesal, peisestue, biljard- og bordtennisrom, spisesal og storkjøkken. Overnatting skjer på 7 hytter, hvorav 5 hytter er nybygg. Rommene varierer fra dobbeltrom til flerpersonsrom (dorms) med inntil 7 sengeplasser. De resterende to hyttene er i 90-talls stil.  Vi er bygget og blir vedlikeholdt primært på dugnad av kjære venner med hjerte for folket i Nordfjord. Fjordly eies av Normisjon region Sogn og Fjordane.  Eiendommen er rusfri sone. Bruk av alkohol og rusmiddel er ikke tillatt inne eller ute på området.  Fjordly er forpliktet på Normisjon sitt kristne verdigrunnlag. Vi ønsker å skape eit helt himmelsk leirsted som har Jesu hjertevarme til alle, men med spesielt hjerte, øyner og ører for barn og unge.
